description:
A payment of $245.00 to 'City Grill' on 2025-05-15 was incorrectly recorded under 'Office Supplies'. Your task is to correct this error.

1. Create a new Expense Account named 'Meals & Entertainment'.
2. Find the payment to 'City Grill'.
3. Edit the payment to reclassify it from 'Office Supplies' to the new 'Meals & Entertainment' account.
4. Save the changes.

Start from the Northwind Traders Summary page.
